homeFocus.text: Vijay Pichumani has shown with Art Houz since 2020, from Kolvel, made during the lockdowns, to By Nature’s Force at Lalit Kala Akademi. His paintings and black-and-white wood carvings come out of long journeys by bike across Tamil Nadu, reading each region through the colour of its soil.
